decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal is considered acceptable because of its size, function and temporary nature would not harm the appearance of the site or the Heston Village Conservation Area, and would serve to further the educational operations of Heston Junior School.  The development is therefore in accordance with policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 3 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period, expiring on or before five years from the date of permission, when the use shall cease.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Installation of single storey temporary mobile classroom
